segments.name: BlackMoldedCase
segments.evidence_basis: Source No.8 case/photo; printed8mm nominal main body; small radii/side reliefs and axial split are unsized.

segments.name: RearWaferAndTerminalCarrier
segments.evidence_basis: Rear wafer and terminal-side projection reconstructed from No.8 photo/outline. Material shade and local wafer thickness/carrier contours unsized; no solder leads.

segments.name: StampedFrontFrameAndCrimps
segments.evidence_basis: Printed9.7mm width, +6.0/-6.5mm outline and8.5mm front datum. Sheet stock, edge folds, side windows and chamfered outline divisions are source-shaped unsized interpretation.

segments.name: FrontRivetHeads
segments.evidence_basis: Two diagonal source-front rivet indications, contained withinZ8.5. Head dimensions/positions are traced visual detail, not fastener specification.

segments.name: UnthreadedSleeve
segments.evidence_basis: PrintedD9 sleeve with5mm projection. No screw thread. Surface groove count/depth and collar lip are unsized visual knurl indications.

segments.name: FL3_FlattedInsulatedShaft
segments.evidence_basis: PrintedFL3 L21.5 from housingfrontZ8.5, D6 shaft,12mm flat,4.5mm across, C1 tip chamfer. Absolute rotary setting is not inferred.

improvements: Replaced solid envelope with molded case, rear wafer/carrier, folded front sheet frame, diagonal rivet indications and grooved sleeve.
Black insulated shaft and sleeve follow original manufacturer photograph; fullFL3 height and printedC1 tip retained.
limitations: Detailed own reconstruction from primary manufacturer drawings; not recovered manufacturer CAD.
Canonical original F.Cu footprint frame: X=footprint X,Y=-footprint Y,Z outward, with housing rear atZ0 as existing seating assumption. No footprint placement or side flip is baked into geometry.
All nominal exterior dimensions and full shaft heights are retained. No resizing or relocation was performed to make the enclosure fit.
Colors/material roles and unsized molding, wafer split, metal stock, crimp folds, rivet diameters and small radii are qualified visual interpretations.

Electrical solder leads, below-seat mounting legs and internal wipers are omitted. Exact lead-form/trim, historical seating gap, tolerances, terminal insertion and complete assembly fit are unqualified.
No exact EVUF2LFL3 manufacturer3DCAD was recovered from the bounded official CAD-index and product searches; no unrelated EVU variant CAD was substituted.
Sleeve groove detail is a visual indication, not an exact crossed-knurl/tooling model. Body/wafer internal splits and colors are reconstructed.
Manufacturer mounting-leg pattern differs from actual original footprint; all below-seat legs omitted and no mounting-hole fit is claimed.
Shaft flat remains on canonical negativeY as prior inspection pose. The source drawing states fullCCW30degrees, but actual fitted rotary state is unmeasured.

segments.name: UnthreadedSleeve
